notes: Boundary and determinism checks use frame(t,30,2), matching the delivery render. Calendar digits may change only within their recorded central bounds (under 20 percent of the frame); the remaining picture keeps the normal continuity requirement and whole-frame changed area is still bounded. Continuity metrics do not replace viewing the moving shots. Visible determinism allows only max 2/255, changed-pixel proportion <0.0002 and mean RGB difference <0.00015; this is not byte identity, and actual differences plus identical PNG counts are reported.

A separately isolated city-line raster case at 182/186s permits at most four RGB channels at 3/255, all inside x1670–1800/y874–892, while retaining the same total changed-pixel and mean limits. Independent cleared-canvas repeats of the city and life scene were exact. See raster-isolation.json. This narrow exception does not change transition limits.
